Australian Coalition Unveils Education Policy Focused on National Identity

The Australian Coalition has announced a new education policy emphasizing national identity, pride in the flag, and Western culture. The plan also includes proposals to bring soldiers into schools to foster respect for the military. This policy aims to instill a stronger sense of patriotism and national values among students. Specific details on the implementation and curriculum changes were part of the announcement.
